name: Superwhisper
summary: Voice-to-text dictation for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android, working offline or in the cloud.
description: Superwhisper lets users dictate into any app with a keyboard shortcut and turns speech into formatted text locally or with cloud models. Pro features can be tried free for a limited word count; Pro and lifetime options are paid tiers.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: 7.24 €/mo (Pro). Pro features can be tried on 3,000 words. A 40% student discount was shown and is not used as the general public price.

howToUse.title: Open Superwhisper
howToUse.description: Open Superwhisper and download it for your computer or phone.

howToUse.title: Dictate with the shortcut
howToUse.description: Select an app, press the keyboard shortcut and dictate. On a Mac that shortcut is Option plus space. Superwhisper turns speech into formatted text. Switch among the formal, casual and legal modes. The transcript is pasted into the app.

howToUse.title: Choose offline, cloud or Pro
howToUse.description: It works offline or with cloud models, supports more than 100 languages, and lets you bring your own API keys. Upgrade to Pro or a lifetime option when you need full access.

features: Voice-to-text dictation for macOS, Windows, iOS and Android, working offline or in the cloud.
Superwhisper lets users dictate into any app with a keyboard shortcut and turns speech into formatted text, with modes such as formal, casual and legal.
It works offline or with cloud models, supports more than 100 languages and lets users bring their own AI API keys.
Pro features can be tried free for a limited word count; Pro and lifetime options are paid tiers.
features_fr: Dictée voix-texte pour macOS, Windows, iOS et Android, travaillant hors ligne ou dans le cloud.
Superwhisper permet aux utilisateurs de dicter dans n'importe quelle application avec un raccourci clavier et transforme la parole en texte formaté, avec des modes tels que formel, informel et légal.
Il fonctionne hors ligne ou avec des modèles cloud, prend en charge plus de 100 langues et permet aux utilisateurs d'apporter leurs propres clés API IA.
Les fonctions Pro peuvent être essayées gratuitement sur un volume limité ; Pro et l'option à vie sont des forfaits payants.
